observations.source: The original reads as a broad, low blue shelf with a nearly flat light-blue top, three dark line cracks, a dark straight front band and one angular projecting flake. The top is visually blank relative to the target; the hard stripe transition and repeated narrow lines feel diagrammatic.
observations.target: The frozen target proposes chunky rounded and layered blue rock slabs, broad cyan top planes, soft beveled edges, a deeper blue lower stratum, sparse purple/green pebbles, and gentle surface variation. Its painted rim glare, bright caustic-like network, and taller-looking image proportions are style cues, not connector/camera/height evidence.
observations.styleReference: The plant reference shows simple saturated material families, readable large forms, softly rounded bright edges, broad shaded volume, and restrained small details; its green/orange palette does not override this rock's blue family.
observations.nativeSource: The actual named collection contains one root, one continuous straight core, three crack meshes and one flake mesh. Core has exact two opposing local-X endpoint rings. No turn is present; variant name does not define handedness.
